scripts.package:mac: npm run build && rm -rf "release/mac-arm64/Pixel Pet.app" release/dmg-staging && unset CSC_LINK CSC_NAME CSC_KEY_PASSWORD CSC_INSTALLER_LINK CSC_INSTALLER_NAME CSC_INSTALLER_KEY_PASSWORD APPLE_ID APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD APPLE_TEAM_ID APPLE_API_KEY APPLE_API_KEY_ID APPLE_API_ISSUER && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 && mkdir -p release/dmg-staging && ditto "release/mac-arm64/Pixel Pet.app" "release/dmg-staging/Pixel Pet.app" && ln -sfn /Applications release/dmg-staging/Applications && hdiutil create -volname "Pixel Pet" -srcfolder release/dmg-staging -ov -format UDZO "release/Pixel Pet-1.0.0-arm64-unsigned.dmg" && (cd release && shasum -a 256 "Pixel Pet-1.0.0-arm64-unsigned.dmg" > "Pixel Pet-1.0.0-arm64-unsigned.dmg.sha256")
